bugs.error_message: VUID-vkCmdTraceRaysKHR-None-08608: VkPipeline does not set up VK_DYNAMIC_STATE_VIEWPORT|VK_DYNAMIC_STATE_SCISSOR but calls related dynamic state commands

Donut avoids it by using volatile buffers (no endRenderPass in writeBuffer).

bugs.fix: Moved UploadCmdList->open() to after the KTX loading loops, so it only opens once per-texture command lists have been closed and executed by LoadKTX2Texture/LoadTexture.

bugs.error_message: Few-bounce GI output is sparse snow-flower noise with no coherent shading or direct lighting; per-frame flicker
bugs.root_cause: (1) RayGen fires 1 ray per pixel — no SPP loop. (2) ClosestHit declares 'in float3 hitAttr : SV_HitT' but SV_HitT is a scalar (ray T); HLSL broadcasts to (T,T,T) and normalize() yields constant (0.577,0.577,0.577) — every surface in bounces 1-3 has identical NdotL. (3) albedo is hardcoded float3(0.7) — no GBuffer sampling at hit. (4) throughput *= 0.5 per bounce darkens GI further. ReSTIR resamples a 1-SPP input, FrameIndex in candidate hash causes per-frame flicker, spatial pass adopts neighbor's y (random screen pixel) and discards W weight.
bugs.fix: P0: Fix FewBounceGI.hlsl — remove hitAttr as normal, use WorldRayOrigin()+WorldRayDirection()*RayTCurrent() for hitPosition, sample GBuffer at hit, add SPP loop in RayGen. P1: ReSTIR_Generate — drop FrameIndex from candidate positions, increase radius, apply W in spatial output, use real BRDF evaluation. P2: Remove unused TemporalRadiance/RadianceHistory textures.

Remaining issues: (1) RayGen still 1-SPP, (2) albedo still hardcoded float3(0.7) in FewBounceGI.hlsl:258 (TODO), (3) no shadow ray / no sky-occlusion ambient, (4) ReSTIR_Generate_cs.hlsl:76 puts FrameIndex INSIDE the candidate-position hash so y flickers per frame on a static scene, (5) ReSTIR_Spatial_cs.hlsl:130 computes W then discards it (raw gRadiance[y] output), (6) ReSTIR_Temporal binds CurrentRadiance/HistoryRadiance/OutRadiance but the temporal shader doesn't read or write them — temporal pass is reservoir-only and does not stabilize per-frame output.
bugs.fix: P0 (recognizable Sponza): (A) Sample GBufferDiffuse at hit position for albedo in FewBounceGI.hlsl:258. (B) Add SPP loop in RayGen — for s=0..SPP accumulate payload.radiance. (C) Sky-occlusion ambient in ClosestHit — SampleSky(hitNormal)*0.3. P1 (kill flicker): (D) Remove gConstants.FrameIndex from candidate-position hash in ReSTIR_Generate_cs.hlsl:76 — use hash22(pixel + float2(i*7, i*13)) and keep FrameIndex only on the selection step (line 91). (E) Apply W in spatial output: gOutput = float4(outRadiance * W, 1.0) with W clamped to [0,5]. P2: tighten normal/depth thresholds in spatial pass, increase generation radius after SPP fix, wire up or remove TemporalRadianceTexture/RadianceHistoryTexture.

bugs.error_message: ReSTIR snow-flower flicker + uniform-gray bounce + ViewConstants reading garbage. Post-fix from bug-046.
bugs.root_cause: Three independent bugs fixed in commit 2d36716: (1) ReSTIR_Spatial used naive 'pick one y from neighbor, output radiance[y]' — for 1-SPP input this propagates a single bright speckle to 9 spatial neighbors with no calibration, causing the snow-flower flicker. (2) FewBounceGI.hlsl ClosestHit used per-instance info.AlbedoColor which was unset/zero for the few-bounce path, making all bounce-hit materials look uniform gray regardless of Sponza's actual red/marble/brick textures. (3) TestFewBounceGI.cpp binding layout declared ViewConstants at slot 512 — should be 257 (b0=256, b1=256+1) given bRegShift=256 — so the GI shader was reading the wrong constant buffer for camera/clip-space info, producing nonsense clipPos in the new GBuffer reprojection path.
bugs.fix: (1) Replaced spatial merge with pairwise MIS weighted blend: numerator = sum_i(w_sum_i * radiance_i), denominator = sum_i(M_i * p_hat_i), output = numerator/denominator. Added MaxM clamp and per-reservoir radiance lookup. (2) In FewBounceGI.hlsl ClosestHit, replaced `float3 albedo = info.AlbedoColor` with screen-space reprojection of the primary pass's GBufferDiffuse texture: project hit position through ViewMatrix*ProjMatrix, sample GBufferDiffuse.Load at the resulting pixel. (3) Changed BindingLayoutItem::ConstantBuffer(512) -> ConstantBuffer(257) and matching BindingSetItem::ConstantBuffer(512, ...) -> ConstantBuffer(257, ...) in TestFewBounceGI.cpp.

bugs.error_message: TestPathTraceGI shows 'full white noise' — Display mean luma ~0.80 with no shading variation; image is uniformly pale (looks like white noise)
bugs.root_cause: Default exposure=1.0 in FPathTraceGIPass::Initialize. With the configured Cornell area light (intensity=2.0 at distance ~1, 2x2 area) and 4 SPP x 3 bounces, total HDR radiance averages ~1.0 (saturates ACES at >~2.0). ACES compresses all variation into a narrow bright band (p99=0.88, p01=0.72), making the image look uniformly pale / 'white noise'. GBufferMaterial G channel also dropped to 0 in the dumps because saturated R,B dominate the linear→sRGB clamp and G came out ~0 from the same oversaturation.

Override still available via HLVM_PT_EXPOSURE env var. Also added sat% / black% percentile stats to DumpRGBA32FTexture log output so future regressions can be diagnosed without dumping PNGs.

bugs.error_message: TestReSTIR_GI_Temporal dumps all-black with no console errors; validator passed because NVRHI's validator was silently swallowing all GPU work after the first immediate-CL collision
bugs.root_cause: validation-commandlist.cpp open() — for immediate command lists, when m_NumOpenImmediateCommandLists > 1, the code called error() and `return;` BEFORE m_CommandList->open(). The return skipped open(), so every subsequent setGraphicsState/dispatch/drawIndexed on the wrapper is recorded into a closed/no-op command list. Combined with two IMPLICIT immediate CLs (DeviceManager's and the test's Render()), the immediate counter overflows on frame 1 and silently drops all GPU work for every frame.
bugs.fix: Patched validation-commandlist.cpp: replaced `error(...) + return` with `warning(...)` (no return) so that m_CommandList->open() still executes after the immediate-counter overflow. Rebuilt libnvrhid.a manually with clang++-17 + llvm-ar-17 (skipping ninja's FetchContent reconfigure that fails on parallel-hashmap network clone) and relinked TestReSTIR_GI_Temporal directly. bugs.error_message: TestReSTIR_GI_Temporal raster pass silently produces no fragments — smoke PS (1,0,0,1) never overwrites GBuffer sentinel values
bugs.root_cause: Raster pass GPU commands dropped between nvrhi::setGraphicsState and the draw call. Confirmed via smoke PS (literal (1,0,0,1) red never appears in any dump; sentinel values from WriteGBufferSentinels persist). Suspected: persistent nvrhi immediate CommandList's internal state machine dropping per-frame draw work after a sentinel-write flush. Attempts that did NOT help: (a) switching to non-immediate CommandList, (b) patching nvrhi validation counter-overflow early-return, (c) patching nvrhi CLOSED-state for immediate CL, (d) removing Proj[2][2] Z-flip from glm::perspective.
bugs.fix: Reverted GBufferPT_PS.hlsl from smoke-PS to real implementation (no functional fix landed). Status: UNRESOLVED. Sentinel writes work, dump pipeline works, but raster pass remains dead. To re-attempt: debug nvrhi::DeviceManagerVk (Vulkan) immediate-CL submission path or rewrite raster pass with full TestRTShadowsGBuffer-style pre-baked pipeline setup.

bugs.error_message: TestReSTIR_GI_Temporal raster pass silently produces no fragments — fix verified
bugs.root_cause: Vulkan validation-layer layout error in a LATER pass (the TemporalReservoir0/1 SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL vs GENERAL mismatch from bug-075) was retroactively dropping ALL GPU work recorded earlier in the same CommandList submission, including the raster pass. When the raster pass was combined with later passes in one CommandList, all raster setGraphicsState/drawIndexed calls were silently invalidated. Confirmed by diagnostic gradient PS: 16384 unique pixels (worldpos) + 140218 unique pixels (normal) when raster pass was isolated, vs uniform saturated sentinel when combined.
bugs.fix: In RenderGBuffer (after the per-mesh loop), close+execute the CommandList, waitForIdle, then reopen the CommandList for the remaining passes (FGIPass, denoise, ReSTIR). Removed the duplicate close+execute at the end of Render(). This isolates the raster pass into its own submission so a validation error in a later pass cannot retroactively drop raster work. Also added validation .o files (validation-commandlist.cpp.o, validation-device.cpp.o) to libnvrhid.a (they were missing after yesterday’s patches).

bugs.error_message: ReBLUR denoiser was a pass-through: denoised ~= spatial (HF drop 0-2%), SpatialAlpha never sent, NaN weights from uninitialized GBuffer sky texels, broken view-space plane rejection
bugs.root_cause: Dispatch read Constants.SpatialAlpha (memset 0) instead of BlurParams.SpatialAlpha; GBuffer MRTs never cleared so sky texels held NaN bit patterns poisoning the blur weights; ReconstructViewPos fed linear depth into an NDC projection producing garbage plane distances
bugs.fix: SpatialAlpha from BlurParams; clear all 4 GBuffer MRTs each frame (worldpos=0, normal=(0,0,0,1), material=0, depth=0); relative-depth bilateral exp(-|dd|/d*PlaneWeight) with saturate/isfinite guards; tuned defaults (BlurRadius 8, NormalWeight 2, PlaneWeight 12, SpatialAlpha 1.0)

bugs.error_message: Validator blind spots: never inspected spatial/denoised, so a bypass (HLVM_RGI_BYPASS=1) or dead-ReSTIR run passed 4/4
bugs.root_cause: Validator was designed around 'non-black structured image' but not 'ReSTIR+denoise stages executed and changed the signal'
bugs.fix: Added check_restir_alive (spatial/denoised mean > 5) and check_denoise_effective (MAE > 0.5 and HF ratio < 0.99); both skippable via HLVM_VALIDATE_ALLOW_BYPASS=1; display-std threshold recalibrated 30->20 for the new sky background

bugs.error_message: Display 56% black: no background for sky pixels; RayGen early-returned (0,0,0,1) and ReBLUR zeroed depth==0 pixels
bugs.root_cause: No environment/background term on the primary path; the miss shader already had SampleSky() but primary sky pixels never traced a ray
bugs.fix: RayGen no-geometry branch unprojects the primary ray (GLM RH-ZO diagonal + mul(vec,view)) and writes SampleSky(primaryDir); ReBLUR passes sky radiance through instead of black; display black% 56% -> 0.0%

bugs.error_message: ReSTIR spatial resolve pass-through: output selectedRadiance*W with W==1 collapsed to gi_raw; absolute-depth rejection over-rejected far surfaces
bugs.root_cause: Resolve performed unbiased reservoir selection but never combined accepted neighbors; with homogeneous radiance the selection is a no-op
bugs.fix: Weighted-average resolve sum(w_i*r_i)/sum(w_i) with w_i = target*W*M; relative-depth rejection |dd|/d > DepthThreshold; spatial HF now below gi_raw on G/B

bugs.error_message: GBufferPT_VS unconsumed vertex attributes (locations 2/3) + duplicate GIPathTracing.hlsl divergence (ninja declares Private copy but ShaderMake compiles the cfg-relative test-data copy)
bugs.root_cause: Input layout declared UV/TANGENT the VS never reads (2 Vulkan warnings); GIPathTracing.hlsl exists in Private + test data + TestPathTraceGI_Data with divergent content and the build dependency graph pointed at a different file than the compiler read
bugs.fix: Removed the 2 unused attributes; synced all three GIPathTracing.hlsl copies to the ReSTIR variant (OutputDirection u2 is always bound with a dummy in FGIPass); create_restir_gi_temporal_shadermake now declares the test-data source; verified TestPathTraceGI still passes

bugs.error_message: GBuffer had no depth occlusion: D32 texture created but never attached, depth test/write disabled -> Sponza rendered as 'inside-out mesh' (interior surfaces showing through the facade)
bugs.root_cause: GBufferDepth (D32) was created but never added to the framebuffer; the GBuffer pipeline disabled depth test/write, so every overlapping mesh fragment wrote the GBuffer and the last-drawn mesh won per pixel
bugs.fix: Attached GBufferDepth via FBDesc.setDepthAttachment, enabled DepthTest/DepthWrite with ComparisonFunc::Less, clear depth 1.0 per frame; before/after ASCII comparison in SCREENSHOTS_2026-08-10.md shows the interior patchwork gone

bugs.error_message: validate_restir_gi.py hardcoded to frame8 dumps: glob '*frame8.png' and all per-check filename patterns ignored frame-16/32 runs, so longer accumulation runs could not be validated
bugs.root_cause: Frame number was baked into filename filters ('display_frame8', 'spatial_frame8', ...) instead of matching any frameN
bugs.fix: Glob '*frame*.png' and match 'display_frame' / 'spatial_frame' / 'denoised_frame' substrings; group anchoring uses the newest display of any frame number

bugs.error_message: Camera was outside Sponza; lighting was flat ambient + interior point lights (no sunlight look)
bugs.root_cause: Original exterior camera (0,6,24) and v142 AmbientScale=1.5 + point-light fallback washed out the scene
bugs.fix: Scene rotated 90° around Y (TLAS + raster consistent), camera placed inside the hall (env-tunable), sun-only NEE light buffer (intensity 8) + low sky-tinted ambient 0.35; validator made frame-agnostic

bugs.error_message: ReadbackTextureFloats forced alpha=1.0 on every dump: hid the material roughness (GBufferMaterial.a) and made the validator's alpha-sentinel check trivially pass even when the GI dispatch never ran
bugs.root_cause: OutPixels[DstIdx + 3] = 1.0f hardcoded in the readback loop
bugs.fix: Copy the source alpha channel; validator alpha check now reflects the real GPU alpha (sentinel still saturates 255 on valid runs)

bugs.error_message: Sponza materials were fake: palette-hash albedo (neutral materials got arbitrary per-name colors), no textures, no roughness -> 'colored pillars' and wrong GI
bugs.root_cause: GetMeshAlbedo hashed mesh names into an 8-color palette; the GBuffer wrote a flat constant; GI bounce used the same palette; roughness ignored
bugs.fix: Material rework Phases 1-4: UV re-added, per-mesh real KTX2 albedo textures bound and sampled, roughness packed into GBufferMaterial.a and consumed by a roughness lobe, bounce albedo = texture linear average, palette hack removed; see PLAN_MATERIAL_REWORK_2026-08-10.md

bugs.error_message: vkAcquireNextImageKHR(): Semaphore must not have any pending operations (VUID-vkAcquireNextImageKHR-semaphore-01779) once the per-frame waitForIdle is removed — acquire semaphores are reused before their pending signal completes
bugs.root_cause: m_AcquireSemaphoreIndex cycles faster than the semaphore's queued wait completes when frames overlap (waitForIdle was masking it)
bugs.fix: TODO: track a per-index event query and wait it before re-acquiring with that semaphore; then the per-frame waitForIdle in RunMessageLoop can be removed (~42 ms/frame in the half-res ReSTIR test vs 64 ms)
